How it works in the group

Spin just for fun — the coins are make-believe and there's nothing to buy. Wins pay left to right on 9 lines across the 5 reels: match 3, 4, or 5 symbols along a line to win.

Bonus — free spins & a multiplier: the Cove Wave is also the bonus symbol. Land 3 or more Cove Waves anywhere on the reels (they don't have to be on a line) and you win 10 free spins — no bet taken, and you keep everything you win. Every free-spin win is multiplied: 2× when 3 Waves trigger the bonus, 3× when 4 or more trigger it. Land 3+ Waves again during the free spins and you get 10 more, up to the 3× top multiplier. Your bet stays locked while the free spins play.

Your coins are how you earn your way toward prizes. Build up your balance, take a screenshot showing your coin total, and post it in the Creator's Cove Facebook group — that's your entry. Winners are picked from the screenshots posted in the group.

Land a big win along the way? Tap WINNER CARD for an extra-pretty screenshot to post — it shows your winning line and your coin total together.

Run out of coins? Your next 100 free coins arrive tomorrow — when you hit zero, a countdown timer appears on the machine showing exactly how long is left until midnight. Come back tomorrow, tap to claim your 100, and you're spinning again. Your coin balance is saved on this device, so it's right where you left it when you come back — your session scores start fresh each visit.

Paytable

    Payouts are × your bet, for 3, 4, or 5 of a kind paying left to right on a line. Only the best win on each line counts — but different lines can all win on the same spin. The Cove Wave is wild and stands in for any symbol — and it's the bonus symbol too: 3+ anywhere trigger 10 free spins at a 2× multiplier (4+ trigger at 3×).
